title: Chapter 259 Brief Peace I
content:
Chapter 259 Brief Peace I

Time is long and fleeting.

Now, half a year has passed since that great war. In the past six months, something happened that surprised many people in the world.

First of all, the original upper, middle and lower battlefields completely stopped this continuous battle with two million people. It made the people of the world, who were already overwhelmed by the war, have a little respite.

However, before they could breathe a sigh of relief and enjoy this rare moment of peace, another piece of news that made them feel hopeless came.

The leader of the alliance, the current Hezong Chang Yuguo. In the case of his defeat in the central battlefield, another 150,000 troops were urgently transferred from the country, preparing to provoke another war against Qin.

Such a desperate news caused even greater panic in the world.

They vaguely understand that the war does not seem to stop because of their wishes. On the contrary, there is an intensifying trend, and the scope of the war will gradually spread from the border between the central coalition forces and Qin to the entire world.

Drag all the common people into the flames of war until they burn out and lose all their strength.

However, just when everyone thought they were about to face another battle, although the scale was not as large as the one million people before, it still had a battle of 700,000 to 800,000 people.

Just when they were mentally prepared to face greater suffering and death, a dramatic change took place in the war.

Qin, who has always been known for being fearless, brave and good at fighting, actually retreated for the first time in the face of the provocation of the coalition forces.

There wasn't even a direct confrontation, there wasn't even a checkout with a scale of thousands of people, and they fled far away when they heard the news of the coalition forces. The entire Sanchuan County was evacuated, and the 400,000 people there were handed over to the coalition forces and South Korea.

Although this sudden news was expected by the coalition forces, it still surprised them. Especially King Han, he is already mentally prepared to lose the remaining 20,000 troops. After all, this time it is for South Korea to seize territory and make sacrifices, which is what it should be.

But who would have thought that the state of Qin would be like this? This news undoubtedly made King Han overjoyed. He saved his current strength and won the twelve counties of Yingchuan County that had not been affected by the flames of war. The county is really a windfall.

As for the other countries, this expedition was originally intended to completely contain the strength of the Qin State within the Hangu Pass, and to support the weak South Korea by the way.

So although I feel extremely jealous of South Korea's luck this time, it's just a few complaints in my heart, a little bit of dissatisfaction, and I didn't say anything about regretting it.

What's more, it is also good news for all countries that the Qin army can be forced to return to Hangu Pass without losing any troops.

Today's countries, like South Korea, have experienced the spread of war, and they are all rotten.

If they continue to lose some troops, it is undoubtedly compromising their respective national strengths, why bother!

In short, as Qin State's troops were all shrunk back to Hangu Pass, the war between Qin State and the Alliance, which lasted for three years, finally subsided completely.

The people of the world finally ushered in the so-called peace in their eyes!

But, how long can this peace last? No one can know.

In the eyes of the people of the world, the alliance has acquired so many territories this time, and it must take a good rest for decades, at least ten years, to digest the annexation and restore its own strength damaged by the war. Qin will also hide in Guanzhong, secretly licking the pain suffered by the war.

For these reasons, the people of the world take it for granted that they can enjoy a period of peace, which will last for 5 to 10 years.

Therefore, whether it is the people of the world, Qin, or even the coalition forces, they all inevitably fall into the yearning for peace.

Slowly, a little relaxed.

Similarly, because the war between the two sides has attracted the attention of the world and attracted the attention of most people. But there was one more thing, which also made the people of the world pay attention to the actions of the coalition army and the state of Qin.

The Taoist sect headed by the Mohist school, the medical school, and the Guigu sect headed by Wei Zhuang, famous scholars, these various schools of thought all announced their move to Yuguo. Only in the original basic sites of their respective schools, some people who could barely take care of them were left stationed, and the rest were all moved to the territory of the Northern Imperial Kingdom.

This news shocked people all over the world, especially the remaining schools of thought who were waiting and watching, they were even more shocked.

They didn't expect that the various schools that they had to look up to in the past would all join together and pledge their allegiance to Yuguo, a barbarian country that just popped up in the north, which really surprised them.

Similarly, this news has also aroused the thoughts of many caring people, making them start to ponder, where will the future of the world go? Will the center of gravity of the world shift from Qin State in the west to Yu State in the north? And the power schools they each represent, will they meet such a fateful choice?

Moreover, apart from the core disciples of this university school, those who really moved to the north also have a large number of forces attached to this university school, including some small schools.

It's just that these schools are too small, and they can only affect one county and one county. They belong to local forces, unlike Mohism and Taoism, which are popular in all countries in the world.

But it is these small schools, the strength of all of them united is not weaker than the big schools of Mohism, but because of the advantage of numbers, they are still superior.

After this, the martial arts in the north of the Imperial Kingdom began to flourish, and various theories proliferated. Although there are countless learned people in the country, they each have their own thoughts. But after all, it is not as good as these schools in terms of organization and scale, and in terms of communication, it is still not as good.

It's just that, in the entire Imperial Kingdom, there is still some resistance to these foreign schools, even though their emperor ordered them to welcome them and arrange them properly.

But it is still impossible for them to let go of everything, integrate with those schools, and accept their ideas. Therefore, some local schools of thought are still deeply rooted.

Therefore, regarding this situation, we started discussions one after another with some famous writers in the country, and with the leaders of various schools, and gradually merged ideas. home confluence.

Such a grand event is already many times more prosperous than the Jixia Academy before Qi's death! It aroused the yearning of all the learned people in the world, and began to go to the imperial country to share the grand event!
